roms.name: Serial echo
roms.description: Echoes every byte received on 2SIO channel A. Identical to the core's built-in default ROM.

roms.name: Hello, world
roms.description: Prints a greeting to 2SIO channel A, then halts. Watch the register bar stop at HALT.

roms.name: Kill the Bit
roms.description: Dean McDaniel, MITS, 1975. A lit bit sweeps across the A8-A15 address lamps; flip the matching sense switch (top row, A8-A15) to knock it out. Clear the board and it stops. The classic front-panel game.

roms.name: Altair 8K BASIC 4.0
roms.description: Microsoft 8K BASIC 4.0 (MITS 1976), the flat load-and-go image (8192 bytes) that reads in from 0000h through the 88-2SIO -- the real paper-tape load. Cold start: MEMORY SIZE? / TERMINAL WIDTH? / WANT SIN-COS-TAN-ATN? (Y). Needs ~12K of RAM.

roms.name: Altair 4K BASIC 4.0
roms.description: Microsoft 4K BASIC 4.0 (MITS 1976) for the 88-2SIO console - the software that made the Altair. Flat 3833-byte load-and-go image; reads in from 0000h. Cold start: MEMORY SIZE? / TERMINAL WIDTH? / SIN? (Y), then OK with ~716 bytes free in a 4K machine.

roms.name: Altair 8K BASIC (ROM build)
roms.description: Mike Douglas's EPROM build of 8K BASIC 4.0: entry at E000h, relocates itself to 0000h. Sits above RAM so it can't stream -- it drops straight in and cold-starts. An instant alternative to the paper-tape 8K image.
